comparison.objective: Candidate removes a connector terminal; record pulls a slip-sheet from beneath a load while bracing the load.
comparison.physical_skill: Wire deflection, tab access, and same-direction tool-wire pull versus bimanual friction management with one hand bracing and the other pulling a flexible sheet.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires selective intact extraction and lacks numeric force/damage thresholds. Record requires full sheet clearance while bounding block displacement, lift, tilt, and final motion.
comparison.reason: Coordinated pulling is generic; latch release and constrained connector access are absent from the slip-sheet task.
